description: Header file defining the TextureStorage11 class and its derived classes for managing D3D11 textures in ANGLE, including multisample and cube textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage11
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing D3D11 texture storage, providing interface for texture operations.

classes.name: TextureStorage11External
classes.description: Manages external textures via EGL images.

classes.name: TextureStorage11ImmutableBase
classes.description: Base class for immutable texture storage where images are fixed.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_EGLImage
classes.description: Handles textures backed by EGL images.

classes.name: MultisampledRenderToTextureInfo
classes.description: Struct containing info for multisampled render-to-texture operations.

methods.name: getMippedResource
methods.description: Returns a mipmapped version of the resource if available.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target view for a given image index.

methods.name: associateImage
methods.description: Associates an Image11 with the texture storage.

methods.name: disassociateImage
methods.description: Disassociates an Image11 from the texture storage.

methods.name: releaseAssociatedImage
methods.description: Releases the image associated with a specific image index.

methods.name: createSRVForSampler
methods.description: Creates a shader resource view for sampling.

methods.name: createSRVForImage
methods.description: Creates a shader resource view for an image.

methods.name: createUAVForImage
methods.description: Creates an unordered access view for an image.
